name: 月竹 · 素月弧弓
design: A calm scholarly archer's MOON-CRESCENT BOW: slender clean continuous IVORY/PALE BAMBOO composite limbs with a fine deep-teal inner edge, forming an elegant smooth elongated crescent with modest recurves and very spare ornament. A single small smooth JADE crescent inset at limb root and two restrained aged-bronze collars, pale gray-green woven central handle. No bamboo-node segmentation, no feathers/wings/cloud ornaments or dangling pendants. Single perfectly straight dark string between tips. Arrow straight pale bamboo shaft, a narrow simple SILVER triangular leaf point, small IVORY-and-TEAL neat feather fletching with plain rear nock. Existing quiver pale bamboo/teal cloth-faced with ONE simple bamboo silhouette and three matching arrow feathers. Quiet restrained long curves and pale large value mass distinguish from other themes, not generic brown wood bow.
